data_fields.name: dependency_wait_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: required dep: wait until present; optional dep: wait only if present

best_idea: Refuse to publish a content pack whose required rows are missing or whose names clash, naming the missing rows or the cycle, instead of letting a later pack silently replace an earlier one.
decision_why: Zones and legends reference each other by row id, so the same missing-reference and clash checks belong at publish; the donor's silent override is rejected because the live world is one ledger; the Lua sandbox is rejected because user content is rows, not code.
acceptance: A server publish test sends a zone pack that needs an absent legend pack and a second pack with a duplicate name; both are refused with the missing or clashing names, and the live zone list is unchanged afterwards.
